scope: TensorRT resnet50 (torchvision-classifier) app gate on Jetson Orin ARM64 (TRT 10.16.2); promotes the TRT cell of `Classification (torchvisionclassifier, torchvision_classifier)` from B to P. P covers this model + environment only.

build.flags: -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DDEFAULT_BACKEND=TENSORRT (existing build-nano-trt dir; not a fresh configure)
build.export: neuriplo-tasks@v0.8.5 export/classification/torchvision/export_torchvision_classifier.py --library torchvision --model resnet50 --export_format onnx (torch 2.15.0 / torchvision 0.29.2 / onnx 1.23.2, weights fetched by torchvision DEFAULT)

gate.checked: app returned 5 ranked Classification results (5 label bands rendered; this OpenCV-free build draws bands without text by design, see renderRankedLabels). Semantic validity cross-checked in venv: torchvision resnet50 DEFAULT weights on data/dog.jpg give top-1 malamute 0.29, then bicycle-built-for-two, mountain bike, Eskimo dog, Tibetan mastiff.
